i3c_api.h

Configure and use the I3C controller for private transfers and device access.  The API exposes controller initialization, transfer, status, and teardown calls.

i3c_api_init
int32_t i3c_api_init(
uint32_t 
instance
)

Initializes a platform I3C instance with legacy-I2C compatibility enabled and hot-join disabled.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

Platform I3C instance index.

Returns

0 on success; -ENOSYS when the instance has no platform base; -EBUSY when another instance is already open; otherwise returns the status from socfpga_i3c_init().

i3c_api_init_with_base
int32_t i3c_api_init_with_base(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Initializes the singleton I3C API using an explicit MMIO base address.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

MMIO base address of the I3C controller.

Returns

0 on success; -EBUSY when another instance is already open; otherwise returns the status from socfpga_i3c_init().

i3c_api_close
int32_t i3c_api_close(
void
)

Deinitializes the active I3C instance and clears the singleton handle after a successful close.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL when no instance is open; otherwise the I3C driver deinitialization status.

i3c_api_deinit
int32_t i3c_api_deinit(
void
)

Alias of i3c_api_close() for callers using init/deinit naming.

Returns

The status returned by i3c_api_close().

i3c_api_get_status
int32_t i3c_api_get_status(
uint32_t 
*
status
)

Reads the status value from the active I3C controller.

Parameters
status
uint32_t*

Receives the controller status value.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL when no I3C instance is open or the driver rejects the output pointer.

i3c_api_get_hw_capability
int32_t i3c_api_get_hw_capability(
uint32_t 
*
capability
)

Reads the hardware-capability value reported by the active I3C controller.

Parameters
capability
uint32_t*

Receives the hardware-capability value.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL when no I3C instance is open or the driver rejects the output pointer.

i3c_api_i2c_legacy_read
int32_t i3c_api_i2c_legacy_read(
uint8_t 
i2c_address,
uint8_t 
*
buffer,
uint32_t 
length,
uint32_t 
*
response
)

Reads bytes from a legacy I2C target through the active I3C controller.

Parameters
i2c_address
uint8_t

Legacy I2C target address.

buffer
uint8_t*

Destination buffer.

length
uint32_t

Number of bytes to read.

response
uint32_t*

Receives the controller response/status word.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL when no I3C instance is open or arguments are invalid; -EIO or -ETIMEDOUT may be returned by the transfer path.

i3c_api_raw_transfer
int32_t i3c_api_raw_transfer(
socfpga_i3c_transfer_t 
*
transfer
)

Executes a caller-supplied I3C transfer synchronously on the active controller.

Parameters
transfer
socfpga_i3c_transfer_t*

Transfer descriptor passed to the I3C driver.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL when no I3C instance is open or the descriptor is invalid; -EBUSY, -EIO, or -ETIMEDOUT may be returned by the transfer path.
